description: Look up the name, symbol, decimals and total supply of an ERC-20 token contract on Base, live from the contract. Use to identify an unknown token address or to format raw amounts; for a holder's balance use base_token_balance. Input is the token's 0x contract address; an address that is not an ERC-20 contract returns 422, uncharged. Example: token=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
name: base_token_info
title: Base ERC-20 token info
